pattern_name: GitLab API ci_config_path Null Despite Working CI (2026-07)
summary: GitLab REST field ci_config_path can be null/blank even when a default .gitlab-ci.yml exists and pipelines are succeeding; avoid using it as a CI-adoption signal.
notes: Prefer detecting CI by checking .gitlab-ci.yml existence or by pipeline presence; interpret ci_config_path null as default/unknown rather than CI-absent.
